scripts.build:ui: esbuild admin/app.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=.wrangler/admin-assets/app.js && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');for(const f of ['index.html','styles.css'])fs.copyFileSync('admin/'+f,'.wrangler/admin-assets/'+f)"
scripts.build: npm run build:ui && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.admin.jsonc --outdir .wrangler/admin-bundle && wrangler deploy --dry-run --config wrangler.update.jsonc --outdir .wrangler/update-bundle
